_nota: Iconos del canal (16/11/2026). Elegido: cruz grande (cruz latina de luz, acuarela suave como el banner, 26 % menos de saturación). Tercera ronda: Carlos quiere el Evangelio abierto más grande, con el código del idioma (ES/EN/PT) escrito en sus páginas y no en la cruz; las páginas se pintan VACÍAS y las letras se añaden por programa (proceso/icono_idiomas.py) para que no haya erratas.

referencias.rol: Style reference (the channel banner): copy ONLY its watercolor technique, soft palette and light. Do NOT copy its text, its composition or its birds.

The icon the owner chose. Keep its soft watercolor style, colours and mood: dusky violet-blue and rose clouds in a disc, bold golden rays, a luminous cream-gold Latin cross with a deep-amber edge. Change ONLY what the new instructions say.

comun: Delicate watercolor app icon, square 1:1, same soft style and pastel palette as the references: wet-on-wet washes, visible cotton-paper texture. Paint the sky wash FULL-BLEED to all four edges (no white paper border). Keep everything important well inside a central circle so a circular crop loses nothing. Strong TONAL contrast (light cross and pages against a clearly darker surrounding), few big simple shapes, readable at 32 pixels. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no marks, no people, no faces, no watermark.

variantes.libro_a: Same concept as the chosen icon, but re-balanced: the Latin cross is smaller, about 55 percent of the icon height (the vertical beam still clearly LONGER than the crossbar, lower arm about twice the upper arm), and the open Gospel book at the base is MUCH BIGGER: it spans about 70 percent of the icon width and about a third of its height, seen slightly from above facing the viewer, with two large, clearly separated, completely EMPTY cream pages (no text, no lines, no drawings, only a faint warm watercolor wash and paper texture) and a deep-amber cover edge. The cross rises from the book's spine.
variantes.libro_b: Same concept as the chosen icon, but re-balanced: the cross is about 50 percent of the icon height, still a Latin cross (vertical beam clearly longer than the crossbar), and the open Gospel book is the second hero: seen almost straight from the front, spanning about 75 percent of the icon width, with two big flat rectangular cream pages, completely EMPTY (no text, no lines, no marks; only a faint warm watercolor wash), a thin deep-amber cover edge, and golden light rising from its pages up into the cross, which stands behind the spine.
